name: flightterm
description: Flight tracking terminal — React + Express. v5.3.0 adds the Flight Dossier: a URL-addressable full-page deep dive at #flight=<icao> aggregating every data source (identity, live telemetry, filed route, track map, altitude/speed profiles, correlation layer, historical sightings, anomaly history, dep/arr METARs, active SIGMETs, external jump-outs).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,swim --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:swim"
